title: P550e Autobiography
infotainment: Pivi Pro 13.1-inch curved-glass touchscreen, 13.7-inch digital cluster, Meridian Signature Sound (35-speaker)
adasStandard: Full Driver Assist Pack standard: Adaptive Cruise with Steering Assist, AEB, Blind Spot Assist, Lane Keep, Driver Condition Monitor, 3D Surround Camera, Rear Traffic Monitor, Adaptive Speed Limiter. Source: https://www.landroverwhiteplains.com/research/2025-range-rover-trim-levels.htm
adasOptional: Standard at this trim level — Drive Pro Pack includes everything in the Driver Assist Pack. Park Assist Pack (semi-automated parking) is optional. Source: https://www.landroverwhiteplains.com/research/2025-range-rover-trim-levels.htm
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard high-resolution rear view camera with dynamic guidelines, integrated into the 13.1-inch Pivi Pro touchscreen. Source: https://www.landroverusa.com/range-rover/range-rover/index.html
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard 3D Surround Camera (360-degree) with ClearSight ground view (transparent hood for off-road), and ClearSight Interior Rear View Mirror that switches between traditional mirror and rear-camera feed. Source: https://www.landroverusa.com/range-rover/range-rover/index.html
subscriptionFeatures: InControl Remote, Online Pack, Wi-Fi, SOS / Optimized Assistance — all subscription-gated after complimentary period (~$100–200/year combined). No hardware features (heated seats, ADAS, performance) subscription-locked. Source: https://www.landroverusa.com/ownership/infotainment-systems/subscriptions.html
drmNotes: Vehicle operates fully offline. Remote App (precondition, lock/unlock, find car, geofencing) requires an active InControl Remote subscription; expiry disables remote features but does not disable the car. Pivi Pro infotainment functions locally. Source: https://www.landroverusa.com/ownership/infotainment-systems/pivi-faqs.html
killSwitchNotes: Data unavailable: JLR has made no public commitment on IIJA Section 24220 impaired-driving prevention implementation. Standard Driver Condition Monitor camera-based drowsiness detection is present but does not prevent vehicle operation.
knownIssues: Same L460 generational issues — air-suspension faults, Pivi Pro freezes, 12V battery drain. Autobiography-specific reports include 4-zone climate-control glitches and Class Comfort-Plus rear-seat motor faults. Source: https://www.rangerovers.net/
recalls: Data unavailable: NHTSA recall lookup for 2025 Range Rover P550e Autobiography was not directly enumerable from search; check https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls with the specific VIN.
stateIncentives: Federal $7,500 PHEV credit expired Sep 30, 2025. State: CO offers up to $5,000 PHEV credit through 2028; most other states (CA, NY, NJ) have no consumer PHEV credit on a $150k+ vehicle. Source: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/hybrids-evs/electric-cars-plug-in-hybrids-that-qualify-for-tax-credits-a7820795671/

title: P550e SE
driverAssistBrand: Driver Assist Pack (no proprietary marketing name like Super Cruise)
infotainment: Pivi Pro with 13.1-inch curved-glass touchscreen, 13.7-inch digital instrument cluster, OTA capable
adasStandard: Standard ADAS suite includes Adaptive Cruise Control with Steering Assist, Emergency Braking (auto), Blind Spot Assist, Driver Condition Monitor, Lane Keep Assist, Rear Traffic Monitor, and 3D Surround Camera. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/land-rover/range-rover/2025/plug-in-hybrid/features-specs/
adasOptional: Optional Park Assist Pack (Park Assist semi-automated parking, Clear Exit Monitor), Adaptive Speed Limiter, and (with executive Class Comfort-Plus Rear Seat) rear-seat-aware safety features. Source: https://www.landroverwhiteplains.com/research/2025-range-rover-trim-levels.htm
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard high-resolution rear view camera with dynamic guidelines, integrated into the 13.1-inch Pivi Pro touchscreen. Source: https://www.landroverusa.com/range-rover/range-rover/index.html
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard 3D Surround Camera (360-degree multi-view) with ClearSight ground view (transparent hood for off-road), trailer reversing view available with tow pack. No Honda LaneWatch-style single-side camera. Source: https://www.landroverusa.com/range-rover/range-rover/index.html
subscriptionFeatures: InControl Remote (remote start, lock/unlock, vehicle status) — subscription after initial complimentary period; Online Pack (live traffic, online media); Wi-Fi data plan; SOS Emergency Call / Optimized Assistance (Protect package). Pricing varies by retailer (~$100–200/year for Remote+Online combined). No subscription required for heated seats, ADAS, or performance features. Source: https://www.landroverusa.com/ownership/infotainment-systems/subscriptions.html
drmNotes: Vehicle operates fully offline. Remote App (precondition, lock/unlock, find car, geofencing) requires an active InControl Remote subscription; expiry disables remote features but does not disable the car. Pivi Pro infotainment functions locally; navigation and live traffic require Wi-Fi or paired phone data. Source: https://www.landroverusa.com/ownership/infotainment-systems/pivi-faqs.html
killSwitchNotes: Data unavailable: JLR has made no public commitment on IIJA Section 24220 impaired-driving prevention implementation. Standard Driver Condition Monitor camera-based drowsiness detection is present but does not prevent vehicle operation.
knownIssues: L460 generation in early years has shown air-suspension sensor faults, Pivi Pro touchscreen freezes / blackouts, and 12V battery drain when InControl is left active. PHEV-specific reports include EV mode dropping out prematurely under load and longer-than-expected DC fast charge sessions. Source: https://www.rangerovers.net/threads/ (owner forum, multiple threads)
recalls: Data unavailable: NHTSA recall lookup for 2025 Range Rover P550e SE was not directly enumerable from search; check https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls with the specific VIN.
stateIncentives: Federal $7,500 PHEV credit (commercial / leasing path under 45W) expired Sep 30, 2025 — 2025 deliveries before that date may have benefited via lease pass-through. State incentives: CA CVRP closed late 2023; CO offers up to $5,000 state tax credit on PHEVs > 5 mi EV range through 2028; NY/NJ/MA have no PHEV-specific consumer credit. Source: https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/hybrids-evs/electric-cars-plug-in-hybrids-that-qualify-for-tax-credits-a7820795671/
